title: Azure Abyss
description: Beneath the Abyss lies more than just nothingness. Explore a story-driven dimension with new gear, creatures, and secrets.
body:
“Azure Abyss”
— Beneath the Abyss Lies More Than Just Nothingness

This mod adds a series of exploration-based structures and gameplay elements to Minecraft.
As you explore, you’ll uncover clues about the entire game’s lore.

**The current version includes the following:**

- 🌌 **The all-new “Abyss” dimension** – a mysterious, dangerous, and beautiful new world waiting for you to uncover its secrets.

  ![Photo of the new dimension, the Abyss](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11d40af81037d8c18c6b41a12302e94e578c2e9a.png)

- 💎 **New Ore: “Dream Blue”** – Can be used to craft stronger tools and weapons.

  ![Dream Blue ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/740c1ad0088ca63a09011c351546cbda7d05b9f6.png)

- 🧰 **Loot Containers That Can Be Opened with a Crowbar** – Stacks of abandoned wooden chests appear in the wild, while safes can be found deep underground. You’ll need a “crowbar” to open them and retrieve items.

  ![Abandoned wooden crates that spawn in the Overworld, requiring a crowbar to open](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9951843c595b09da3052d7052fae61ab0509ac95.png)

- 👥 **New Villager Professions** – Puppet Merchant and Treasure Merchant, offering you more trading options.

  ![New villager professions: Doll Merchant and Treasure Merchant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2366809ee601dfc4c377359a5683773cff31fad.png)

- 🎎 **Collectible Doll Series** – Includes custom dolls of several friends, each with a unique description.

  ![bluezjx standing in the center, surrounded by a pile of dolls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e46e12cd9542297559fbfe7c73f8954cb6c34a6.png)

- 🔮 **More Secrets to Uncover** – Future updates will add world‑building story clues and new challenges.

Why have they appeared? What drives their rampage?

You’ll have to discover the answers for yourself.

Can you uncover the truth behind these events?  
Can you tell whether it’s the Abyss whispering, or just your own echo?

I don’t know.  
But we can dig deeper together. qwq

—— bluezjx
